map.Real SEO, Google Ads and Meta Ads case s: Real SEO, Google Ads and Meta Ads case studies with the numbers: clicks, impressions, click-through rate, cost per click and more.
map.Skin Body Health had a solid business bu: Skin Body Health had a solid business but struggled with low online traffic. After auditing and optimising the website, we improved its SEO with targeted keywords, fresh content and more. Relevant traffic increased within a month, and by the end of six months the business was getting qualified leads from organic search.
map.Figures from the Google Search Console s: Figures from the Google Search Console screenshot supplied with the project.
map.Allen Jacobi Law had indexing issues des: Allen Jacobi Law had indexing issues despite a strong reputation. After we resolved the indexing problems, optimised the content and added more long-tail keywords, traffic picked up within a month. By the third month, qualified leads were coming in through organic search.
map.Pure Hope Weight Loss had a successful b: Pure Hope Weight Loss had a successful business but was struggling to attract online traffic. We started from the ground up, addressing both technical SEO and on-page optimisation. After auditing and optimising the website, we identified the target audience and the best keywords to attract them, revamped the content to make it more user-friendly and added long-tail keywords to help boost organic traffic.
map.This client had a great app but poor onl: This client had a great app but poor online visibility. After optimising their website and targeting the right keywords, we helped increase their traffic significantly, and users were finally finding the app through organic search.
map.Naples Dent Away, a dent repair service: Naples Dent Away, a dent repair service in Naples, Florida, ran a digital advertising campaign to boost its online visibility. The campaign generated 595 clicks from 25,000 impressions, resulting in 9 conversions. With a total spend of $1,720, the average cost per click was approximately $2.89. While the click-through rate was strong, the campaign points to clear areas for conversion rate optimisation. The business continues to build brand awareness and connect with local customers through strategic digital marketing.

map.Allen Jacobi Law Firm, which specialises: Allen Jacobi Law Firm, which specialises in entertainment law, ran a Google Ads campaign that delivered strong engagement. The campaign generated 717 clicks from 24.3K impressions, with an average cost per click of $0.78 and a total spend of $558, showing effective outreach and targeted visibility.
